lineage.vibe: Static analysis flagged many cross-domain duplicate entities (same entity name owned in two domains): facility (distribution vs manufacturing), storage_location (distribution vs inventory), shipment (distribution vs logistics), cycle_count (distribution vs inventory), dsd_route and dsd_delivery (distribution vs sales), offset_allocation (distribution vs marketing), budget (finance vs marketing), accrual (finance vs promotion), replenishment_order (inventory vs supply), vmi_agreement (inventory vs procurement vs sales), brand (marketing vs product), event (marketing vs promotion), formulation/formulation_ingredient/packaging_spec (product vs research), claim and registration (product vs regulatory), deduction and rebate_agreement (promotion vs sales), stability_study and sample (quality vs research). lineage.vibe: Numerous PII-candidate attributes lack classification tags and need restricted/confidential + PII tagging, including consumer.shopper (date_of_birth, email, first_name, last_name, phone, primary_address_id), consumer.address fields, workforce.employee (date_of_birth, email, first_name, full_name, last_name), workforce.payroll_record (gross_pay, net_pay), workforce.applicant (email_address, expected_salary), finance.bank_account fields, finance.party address fields, logistics carrier/route/driver contact and GPS fields, inventory.warehouse address fields, sales.account_contact and account_address fields, procurement.supplier_site contact fields, and product.product_registration.registered_email. In total 972 attributes match person-data patterns but lack pii_ tags; apply the expected restricted/confidential classification plus a PII tag to all of them.

Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PO creation audit requires recording the buyer employee; this supports PO creation logs and buyer performance analysis.
Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Make‑to‑order production requires linking each sales order to its originating purchase order for planning and cost tracking.
Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: PO execution needs the destination network node to plan inbound shipments, track OTIF, and reconcile inventory at the correct node.
Identifier of the employee who approved the requisition at the current or final approval level.
Identifier of the preferred or recommended supplier for this requisition, based on contracts or sourcing strategy.
Identifier of the cost center that initiated the purchase requisition and will bear the expense.
Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Requisitions must be tied to the network node where the material is needed for accurate supply planning and ATP calculations.
Identifier of the supplier selected and awarded the business based on evaluation criteria. Null if RFQ not yet awarded or cancelled.

Identifier of the business unit, plant, or department that initiated the sourcing request and will consume the procured materials or services.

Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: RFQ evaluation includes the target node to assess lead‑time, capacity, and cost for the intended receipt location.

Standardized spend category classification code used for procurement analytics and reporting. Links to enterprise spend taxonomy.
Employee identifier of the procurement category manager responsible for strategy, supplier relationships, and performance for this category.

Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Contract Management process assigns a responsible employee; linking contract_owner to employee enables ownership tracking and compliance reporting.
Reference to the procurement professional or category manager who conducted the scorecard evaluation.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Certification responsibility is assigned to an employee; needed for audit trails and renewal management.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Hierarchy changes are approved by a designated employee; required for category management reporting.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Label approval workflow requires tracking which employee approved each label for regulatory compliance.
Higher‑level grouping used for reporting and analytics.
Reference to the brand under which the SKU or formulation is being developed or managed. Supports brand-level NPD pipeline reporting and portfolio analytics.
Reference to the internal user (employee or system account) who initiated or triggered this lifecycle stage transition. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: BOM release requires employee approval; tracked for manufacturing release and change control.
Identifies the operational system of record from which this BOM record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and enables multi-system reconciliation.
FK to marketing.brand.brand_id — Links SKU master to brand master. Fundamental for brand-level revenue reporting, portfolio analysis, and marketing attribution.

Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Required for assigning each SKU to its primary distribution node used in supply planning, ATP calculations, and network optimization.
Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Needed for product development cost allocation and regulatory traceability linking each SKU to its originating R&D project.
Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Primary Supplier Assignment for each SKU is required for sourcing strategy, cost analysis, and regulatory compliance reports.

Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Designating a primary supplier site per SKU supports logistics planning, VMI inventory control, and OTIF performance tracking.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for PLM Product Owner assignment; ownership reports need employee responsible for each SKU.
Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: SKU belongs to a product category; linking SKU to category eliminates silo and consolidates category data.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SKU substitution approvals are performed by employees; essential for supply‑chain change control.

Reference to the originating SKU being substituted, superseded, or replaced. This is the 'source' product in the substitution relationship, typically the discontinued, reformulated, or out-of-stock item.
Reference to the business owner (typically from marketing or brand management) responsible for this claim and its usage.
Reference to the principal scientist or researcher responsible for generating and validating the substantiation evidence.

Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Consumer test oversight mandates assigning a principal investigator (employee) to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory documentation.

Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ingredient approval workflow records which employee approved the ingredient, needed for traceability and GMP compliance.

Reference to the supply planning run that generated this projection. Enables traceability to planning execution and version control.
Identifier of the source system that generated this projection (e.g., SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, Oracle Cloud Supply Chain). Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.
Reference to the physical location (distribution center, plant, warehouse) for which inventory is projected.
Identifier of the receiving supply network node (distribution center, warehouse, retail store, or customer location) to which goods are delivered.

Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Node Operations Management Dashboard tracks the manager responsible for each warehouse/distribution node.
Name of the source system from which this OTIF target record originated, typically SAP IBP or customer SLA management system.
Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: otif_target is defined per supply node; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.
Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: OTIF Performance Ownership assigns a responsible employee for each OTIF target in the OTIF Management Dashboard.
Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Supply planning must avoid producing or allocating unregistered SKUs; registration link validates plan feasibility.

Reference to the IBP planning run or DRP execution run that generated this exception.
